summary.tldr: Allows psilocin and psilocybin to be used for medical treatment and makes some priority review requests for new drugs automatically approved.
what_it_does: Allows psilocin and psilocybin to be treated as narcotics for the Narcotic Control Regulations, so they can be used for medical treatment under those rules.
Excludes psilocin and psilocybin from the definition of “restricted drug” for Part J of the Food and Drug Regulations.
Adds the same restricted drug definition to the Food and Drugs Act, again leaving out psilocin and psilocybin.
Deems a request for priority review of a new drug submission to be granted when it is for psilocin, psilocybin, or a substance with a similar chemical structure.
who_it_affects: People seeking psilocin or psilocybin treatment
summary.background: The bill says its purpose is to improve access to hallucinogenic drug medical treatment and not to bypass existing approval processes for new drugs.
